originNote: This repo is deployed by Cloudflare Pages to detoxdenver.org (Search Console property sc-domain:detoxdenver.org). www.diannesplacerecoveryservices.com is a separate Webador site on another host, not this build; until 2026-10-11 every page here canonicalised to that site's homepage and the sitemap listed its URLs. Every absolute URL (canonical, og:url, sitemap, robots, JSON-LD) reads this origin.
name: Dianne's Place Recovery Services
definition: Dianne's Place Recovery Services is a recovery housing and recovery support organization for adults rebuilding life after substance use. It offers structured, substance-free sober living, referral support for families and treatment providers, and plain-language recovery resources. It is not an emergency service; call (720) 588-8864 to ask about availability and fit.

localBusiness.unconfirmedNote: The site shows no street address, hours or confirmed service area (data/geo/market_map.json is non_localized), so these stay null and are omitted from JSON-LD rather than invented.
